question: Construct the actual positive atomic-kernel event adapter and a temperature-dependent conservative cutoff/EOS update, with Wolfram and xAct.

assumptions.statement: Metric (-,+,+,+), explicit c and k_B; source eV converted to SI joules, proper time and fixed collision-stage volume.
Pinned PHYS02C full-BED HI/HeI plus PHYS02B projector/stopping and positive CCC effective-cost tables. Direct new table witnesses use HI 2P.1S and HeI t2S.s1S.
Raw positive node inventory and base thermal reservoir; initial active donor mask and zero-target support fixed during a collision step. Each trial starts from the same raw reference.
Bath screening density n_e=N_e,thermal/V; fixed-energy cold-target coefficients have no direct temperature dependence. Positive Coulomb log and stated cold-target domain required.
Single-temperature nonrelativistic ideal-gas EOS U=(3/2)k_B N T with nuclei included in thermal N. N_B>=N_nuc>0 and U_B>=0; atomic positive-temperature branch driver requires U_B>0.
Continuous spectrum: finite 0th/1st moments, trace or bounded piecewise-continuous density in cutoff bracket; root bracket and C_eff>=m>0 for uniqueness/residual bounds.
Atomic measure: equality assigned to thermal side, retained lower trace, fixed energy/count inventory. Finite forward existence requires chi>=3/2; energy continuation keeps spectrum and N_B fixed.
Covariant spectral balance and boundary traces; F(0)=F(infinity)=0 and W*F(W)->0 for absent endpoint sources. Scalar rest-mass subtraction uses comoving electron number current.

Coupled feedback theorem: declared descriptor self-map, uniform root bracket, positive effective-capacity lower bound and computable q<1. Continuous event coupling uses a trial-z-independent fixed linear reconstruction; atomic version applies within a fixed admitted prefix branch.

Physical time consistency requires a consistent predictor and stated regularity; exact rational endpoint identities and finite root certificates do not replace physical model or time-discretization error.

acceptance: Positive conserving event columns and rate derivative bounds
Finite number/energy partition and EOS root/branch construction
Actual new Wolfram+xAct and scoped Python checks
Independent review bound to exact candidate files
LaTeX/PDF, DAG and resumable source bundle

evidence_reuse.meaning: Eleven selected prior science files match their frozen candidate records; other copied files are provenance, updated metadata or earlier nested derivations.

publication.backup: Dropbox and Google Drive create-only archive; selective R1
publication.authorization: Persistent owner instructions, current next-loop request and prior accepted publication workflow

conventions.base_reservoir: N_B=C-integral(dmu), U_B=E-integral(W dmu); retained lower atoms are subtracted before defining base.
conventions.fixture_temperature: tau=T/Tstar; multiply normalized temperature certificates by Tstar
conventions.continuous_reconstruction: positive moment-preserving fixed linear basis independent of trial z; extra adaptive shape response is a separate term
